race.title: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: MAJOR FORTUNE was a double winner over fences last season and can build on a promising Perth reappearance third to add to his tally here. Lord Of Cheshire has a long absence to overcome but remains with potential and could still have a say with his yard going well, while Sunshine Diamond should strip sharper for a recent Worcester second and play a part. MAJOR FORTUNE (IRE) LORD OF CHESHIRE (FR) SUNSHINE DIAMOND (IRE)
